player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''gsiva''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.
description: this SHOULD be enough to stop WYS, proven that you get a good enough draw.
cards: Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
posted: ghhk/those rebels won't ex-scape us
posted: there'll be hell to pay x2
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: The title says the list is 'from continentals'. Snider's report 'geoff-goes-to-continentals' (DeckTech, 6 August 2001) describes playing this ISB/Scum deck, built with Dave Irvine, on Day 2 of the 2001 North American Continental Championship: wins over Dave Irvine (RST racing) and Matt Sokol (Profit), a loss to Jonny Chu (WYS) — 2–1 with this deck. Part 2 of the report gives his finish as 'i took 7th??? (maybe 8th???)'.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list has no Coruscant-set cards (event was 3–4 August 2001, before Coruscant was tournament legal).
Cards marked (S) as posted: ISB Operations (listed first, unmarked), Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Power Of The Hutt and No Bargain. All count toward the 60.

Posted 'coruscant (S)' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), the ISB Operations system; 'jabba (SE)' Jabba (Special Edition); 'jp audience chamber' the Dark Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark); 'jp lower passageway' Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages; 'tat jabba's palace' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace.

Posted 'joko kast' dested Jodo Kast (the report spells him 'jodo'); 'gamall wironic' Gamall Wironicc; 'epp fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; '4lom w/gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'ig88 w/gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun.

Posted 'twi-lek x2' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'ghhk/those rebels won't ex-scape us' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'oppressive/TINTry' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'secret plans' the Special Edition Effect (the Defensive Shield printing is Reflections III, October 2001).
Ship names: 'zuckuss in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'dengar in P1' Dengar In Punishing One; 'bossk in HT' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
